name: Puzzle From the Future
justification: Constructive output with a wordy setup, but the greedy answer is forced so verdicts are unambiguous.
solution_sketch: d never gains leading zeros, so a longer/lexicographically larger c is always better: greedily set c_i = b_i+1 unless that equals the previous kept digit, else c_i = b_i. Print a_i = c_i - b_i.
